name: DHL Supply Chain - DC - Houston TX

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to 8609 Citypark Loop, Houston TX 77013 (CityPark / East Freeway logistics park). Roster gave no address; a Panjiva import record explicitly names 'Dhl Supply Chain, 8609 City Park Loop, Houston Texas 77013'. Google Geocoding API returned ROOFTOP precision (29.80377, -95.27271). Street View confirmed the building marked '8609' on its SW office front.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The west truck court is enclosed by chain-link fence with a gate at the driveway from Citypark Loop, visible in 2021 Street View and 2026 satellite. Marked uncertain because the gate hardware is partly tree-obscured in Street View; the perimeter fence is clear.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the court entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated truck court with no guard shack implies kiosk / call-box / app check-in.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: The building is a cross-dock with dock doors on BOTH long faces (east and west), each opening to its own truck court — supports separate shipping and receiving dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock canopies line both ~400 m long faces; combined banded estimate 50+. Exact count not resolvable from overexposed white-roof satellite — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in both truck courts (shared with neighbouring buildings); estimated 25-50 stalls.
fieldNotes.railServed: A large Union Pacific rail yard lies just north of the property, but no rail spur runs into the building; road-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within Houston's dense northeast industrial fabric off US-90 / East Freeway; Urban.
